target.question: Estimated probability that at least one new wildfire will start in this 5 km square during the next 24 hours.
target.positive: Verified new wildfire onset inside the square during the valid interval
target.negative: No verified onset AND reporting coverage is adequate for that square-day; otherwise outcome is unknown (not a negative).
not_this_target: Structural or vehicle fires without wildfire confirmation
Agricultural burning unless independently labeled as wildfire onset
Ongoing incidents that started before issue time

reason: 0 usable unique wildfire starts and 0 square-days with credible reporting coverage. Negatives are not supported. Vela will not publish an onset percentage.
